races.name: Frodon & Black Corton At Taunton Novices' Hurdle (Novices' Championship Hurdle Qualifier) (GBB)

runners_data.name: Secret Sniper
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who shaped well at Huntingdon but needs pace to aim at, which looks unlikely here.
runners_data.comment: Shaped well when second at Huntingdon latest; more to offer; shouldn't be underestimated
runners_data.spotlight: A fair bumper performer who shaped well when a clear second of 12 in 2m Huntingdon novice hurdle 22 days ago; this brother to the stable's useful winner Secret Squirrel has more to offer and shouldn't be underestimated.

runners_data.name: Itsinthename
runners_data.note: Another hold-up type whose Catterick win came in a stronger pace scenario than he'll get today.
runners_data.comment: Won at Catterick and built on that with Newbury sixth 20 days ago; this demands more
runners_data.spotlight: Order Of St George gelding; placed in an Irish point and Lingfield bumper (for Nigel and Willy Twiston-Davies) before landing 2m Catterick maiden hurdler for new yard in February; built on that when sixth in 2m4f Newbury novice 20 days ago but this demands another step forward.

runners_data.name: Minella Yoga
runners_data.note: The class act who can control from the front and looks perfectly positioned tactically with 75 days freshening up.
runners_data.comment: Excellent third in Grade 2 at Cheltenham in January; the one to beat back after a break
runners_data.spotlight: Bought for £360,000 after scoring over hurdles at Fairyhouse in November; has created a very good impression for his new yard, following up in Newbury novice (2m) before finishing third of ten in Grade 2 at Cheltenham in January; the one to beat back after a break here.

runners_data.name: Lau And Shaz
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who could press the leader but faces a significant class test after easier recent success.
runners_data.comment: Cosily made it 2-3 for current yard at Hereford 57 days ago; this is tougher however
runners_data.spotlight: Failed to score for Gavin Cromwell but she made it 2-3 for her current yard in 2m Hereford novice hurdle 57 days ago; this is tougher but she scored cosily there.

runners_data.name: Regal Icon
runners_data.note: Pulled up last time at Wincanton and looks completely out of his depth at these odds.
runners_data.comment: Pulled up on hurdling debut at Wincanton in January; significantly more is required
runners_data.spotlight: 100-1, pulled up on his hurdling debut at Wincanton (1m7f, soft) in January; it's easy to look elsewhere.

runners_data.name: Corsican Caper
runners_data.note: Fair flat performer whose third at Doncaster was in a weak novice, needs significant improvement here.
runners_data.comment: A fair 1m6f Flat winner; third at Doncaster latest but this is a much tougher ask
runners_data.spotlight: A fair 1m6f Flat winner; built on his hurdling debut seventh when third of four in 2m Doncaster novice 27 days ago but this demands considerably more.

runners_data.name: Hawa Jumeirah
runners_data.note: Dual flat winner who showed little in three subsequent runs and faces a huge step up in class.
runners_data.comment: Offered little on his yard/hurdling debut at Wincanton (1m7f) in February
runners_data.spotlight: A dual Flat scorer for Ismail Mohammed in the first half of 2025 but he offered little in three subsequent runs in that sphere for Robbie Llewellyn and again on his yard/hurdling debut at Wincanton (1m7f) in February.

races.paceDynamic: Minella Yoga is the only confirmed front runner in this 7-runner field and will face no pace pressure, allowing him to dictate a measured gallop throughout. With most rivals holding up or racing prominently, the early pace will be sustainable rather than testing. The lack of genuine pace angles means the race will likely develop into a tactical affair where the best horse on the day wins. This setup clearly favors prominent racers and the lone leader, as hold-up horses will struggle to make up ground in a slowly-run race with limited pace collapse.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Minella Yoga Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Minella Yoga gets an uncontested lead and maintains his recent form.
scenarios.body: The Paul Nicholls runner can dictate ideal fractions and kick clear when ready, having shown impressive acceleration in his recent Newbury success. His class advantage becomes decisive when allowed to race on his own terms from the front.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners Lau And Shaz or Regal Icon press Minella Yoga early.
scenarios.body: A genuine pace develops that exposes stamina and creates opportunities for the better hold-up horses to close late. The increased gallop brings Secret Sniper and Itsinthename more into contention with their preferred closing kick.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Crawl
scenarios.trigger: If everyone waits and the pace becomes pedestrian throughout.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where raw ability matters most, but hold-up horses still struggle due to lack of pace collapse. Minella Yoga's class tells even more as tactical speed becomes crucial in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Shock Upset
scenarios.trigger: If the market leaders fail to fire and connections get tactics wrong.
scenarios.body: Lower-rated horses like Corsican Caper or Itsinthename capitalize on a messy race where pace and positioning go awry. The race becomes wide open when the expected pattern breaks down completely.

watchPoints.text: Minella Yoga getting an easy lead early - if uncontested, he becomes very hard to peg back with his class advantage.
How aggressively Lau And Shaz or other prominent runners go early - any pressure could change the complexion completely.
Secret Sniper's position turning in - if too far back in a slowly-run race, his finishing kick won't be enough.
Regal Icon's jumping - pulled up last time and any early mistakes will end his chances quickly.
The overall pace through the first mile - a crawling gallop will make it very hard for hold-up horses to get competitive.

races.name: C&D South West Novices' Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Noble Blue
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who has shown consistency lately but remains winless under rules and carries joint-top weight of 168lbs
runners_data.comment: Multiple points winner; very good second at Exeter 23 days ago; can go one better here
runners_data.spotlight: Remains winless under rules but he was a multiple points winner after leaving Paul Nolan in Ireland and has started well for his new yard, a strong-travelling second of 11 in 2m6f handicap hurdle at Exeter 23 days ago; can go one better here.

runners_data.name: Jessmae
runners_data.note: Non-runner who would have been the lone front runner, leaving the pace dynamics completely changed
runners_data.comment: Reliable sort but off for 12 months since good Chepstow chasing second; reverts to hurdles
runners_data.spotlight: Reliable sort but he's still to register a victory and has been off the track for 12 months since posting a good second in 3m Chepstow handicap chase; reverts to hurdles for his comeback run.

runners_data.name: Gasmani
runners_data.note: Prominent type returning from 110 days off and looked rusty last time at Ascot when finishing last of nine
runners_data.comment: Off eight months before last at Ascot in December; needs to take a major step forward
runners_data.spotlight: Low-mileage 7yo; looked rusty after eight months off when last of nine in 3m Ascot handicap hurdle in December; needs to take a major step forward if he's to gain a first victory in this sphere.

runners_data.name: Happy Returns
runners_data.note: Prominent runner coming off a breakthrough 3m win at Wincanton but has been well below par in two runs since
runners_data.comment: Gained breakthrough win at Wincanton in December but well below par both runs since
runners_data.spotlight: Gained her breakthrough success at Wincanton (3m) in December but she's been well below par both runs since, pulled up at Huntingdon (25f) 22 days ago.

runners_data.name: Saint Polo
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who took a big step forward on handicap debut with a clear second at Sedgefield and is up just 5lbs
runners_data.comment: Clear second at Sedgefield latest; up 5lb but first go over this trip here so in the mix
runners_data.spotlight: Brought along steadily before taking a big step forward on his handicap debut when a clear second of seven at Sedgefield (2m4f) last month; up 5lb but remains low mileage and has his first go over this trip.

runners_data.name: Marhaba Million
runners_data.note: Hold-up type from the Flat who is still finding his way over hurdles but showed improvement when sixth at Wincanton
runners_data.comment: Took a step forward when sixth at Wincanton 17 days ago; possibilities off a slipping mark
runners_data.spotlight: A fair 1m4f Flat maiden for Owen Burrows; yet to show that level of form in this sphere but took a step forward when sixth of 12 in 2m4f Wincanton handicap 17 days ago; possibilities off a slipping mark.

races.paceDynamic: Jessmae is the only confirmed front runner but is a non-runner, leaving Noble Blue, Gasmani and Happy Returns as the most likely pace-setters in a small field. Without Jessmae's presence, the early pace will be moderate with these prominent runners not keen to make it a stamina test over 3m. The lack of genuine speed horses means the pace will build gradually, with the final 2f becoming crucial as stamina kicks in. This moderate early pace followed by a sustained finish strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce their best effort late in the race.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays steady through the middle section with no pressure applied
scenarios.body: The moderate gallop plays into the hands of Saint Polo and Marhaba Million who can use their finishing kicks. Both hold-up horses will have plenty left in the tank when the pace quickens approaching the final hurdle.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Control
scenarios.trigger: If Noble Blue or Happy Returns dictate a patient tempo from the front
scenarios.body: These experienced campaigners can measure the pace perfectly and kick clear before the hold-up horses can respond. Their tactical positioning gives them first run on their rivals in the straight.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Stamina Test Develops
scenarios.trigger: If Gasmani or Happy Returns push the pace from halfway to test stamina
scenarios.body: The 3m trip becomes a proper staying test that finds out the less experienced horses. Noble Blue's proven stamina and Happy Returns' recent Wincanton win over the distance become decisive factors.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If all prominent runners go too slow and it becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The race turns into a 2f dash where raw speed matters more than stamina or positioning. This chaotic finish could suit any horse with a turn of foot regardless of their usual running style.

watchPoints.text: Saint Polo could be significantly underestimated after his impressive handicap debut second at Sedgefield last month
Happy Returns has been well below par in her last two runs including a pull-up at Huntingdon just 22 days ago
Gasmani returning after 110 days off and was rusty when last of nine at Ascot in his comeback run
Marhaba Million is still adapting from Flat racing and may not handle the tactical nature of hurdle racing
Noble Blue carries joint-top weight despite being winless under rules which could prove decisive over 3m

races.name: Tony & Carole Stocker Anniversary Surprise Mares' Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Just A Heartbeat
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with tactical advantage over the hold-up majority, though needs to improve on recent poor form and hooded for first time
runners_data.comment: Fontwell runner-up on her hurdling debut last May but she's twice failed to build on it
runners_data.spotlight: Fontwell runner-up on her hurdling debut last May but she's twice failed to build on it, hooded when ninth in 2m Newbury novice in November; needs this switch to handicaps to spark improvement after a break.

runners_data.name: Miracles Do Happen
runners_data.note: Hold-up style disadvantaged by race shape, tongue tie added after going too freely last time at Hereford
runners_data.comment: Too free when only sixth of eight at Hereford (2m) last month; tongue tie is added
runners_data.spotlight: A fair maiden hurdler but she went too freely on her first go in handicaps when only sixth of eight at Hereford (2m) last month; tongue tie is added.

runners_data.name: Bluenose Belle
runners_data.note: Best recent form in field but hold-up style means relying on pace collapse, claimer takes off valuable 3lbs

runners_data.name: Dance Havana
runners_data.note: Prominent style suits race shape perfectly, good recent third over course and distance just 16 days ago
runners_data.comment: Not discredited after two-year absence when third over C&D 16 days ago; possibilities
runners_data.spotlight: A fair 1m6f Flat winner in 2023 for Alice Haynes; lightly raced over hurdles but she wasn't discredited after a two-year absence when third of 13 over C&D 16 days ago; possibilities.

runners_data.name: Ask Peter
runners_data.note: Only front runner should get uncontested lead but poor recent form and 56-day break are concerns
runners_data.comment: A fair 1m6f Flat winner but she's yet to match that form in this sphere; more is required
runners_data.spotlight: A fair 1m6f Flat winner but she's yet to match that form in this sphere and came in a below-par seventh in 2m3f handicap here 56 days ago; more is required.

runners_data.name: Little Venice
runners_data.note: Recent winner but hold-up style requires strong pace to be effective, quirky at start could cost vital position
runners_data.comment: Off the mark at Wincanton latest; quirky and up 4lb but still merits serious consideration
runners_data.spotlight: Quirky sort but she got off the mark in this sphere in 1m7f handicap at Wincanton 43 days ago, despite being reluctant at the start; up 4lb but she still merits serious consideration.

runners_data.name: Aquifolia
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare returning from 169-day break, refitted hood suggests ongoing issues, needs everything to fall right
runners_data.comment: Fair sixth in 2m Worcester handicap in October; returns from a break in a refitted hood
runners_data.spotlight: Still a maiden and she went in snatches when a fair sixth of 14 in 2m Worcester handicap in October; returns from a break in a refitted hood.

runners_data.name: Night Burlesque
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner struggling with consistency, trainer in poor form with 0 from 9 in last 14 days
runners_data.comment: Third on hurdling debut at Warwick but has failed to go on, hooded at Wetherby latest run
runners_data.spotlight: Fair form shown in bumpers and when third on her hurdling debut at Warwick (2m) in October; has failed to go on though and she was tried in a hood when beating only one on her handicap debut at Wetherby (2m) last time.

runners_data.name: For Love Of Beauty
runners_data.note: Weakest form in field, recent breathing surgery and pull-up at Huntingdon highlight significant problems
runners_data.comment: Had wind op before pulled up on yard debut in Huntingdon maiden latest; handicap debutant
runners_data.spotlight: Only poor form shown thus far and she underwent breathing surgery before being pulled up on her yard debut in 2m Huntingdon maiden last month; handicap debutante.

races.paceDynamic: Ask Peter is the only confirmed front runner in this field and should get an uncontested lead, setting a sustainable pace without pressure from prominent runners. Just A Heartbeat and Dance Havana may track in behind, but the majority of this field consists of hold-up horses including Little Venice, Miracles Do Happen, Bluenose Belle, Aquifolia, Night Burlesque, and For Love Of Beauty. With such a lack of early pace and so many runners needing to be delivered late, this race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can sit close to the pace and kick clear before the hold-up brigade can get into contention.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Ask Peter gets an easy lead and stays on strongly
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows the leader to dictate fractions and save energy for a strong finish. The hold-up horses struggle to make up ground as the pace quickens late.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Just A Heartbeat or Dance Havana get first run on the leader
scenarios.body: The prominent runners benefit from tracking the steady pace before quickening clear of both the tired leader and the still-struggling hold-up horses. Their tactical position proves decisive in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Late Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too slow and collapses completely
scenarios.body: The crawling gallop allows the better hold-up horses to close the gap and unleash superior finishing kicks. Little Venice and Bluenose Belle benefit most from their proven ability to quicken.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Ask Peter stops quickly and no one else takes up the running
scenarios.body: The race becomes a scramble with multiple horses still in contention turning for home. Form and class become more important than running style in a messy finish.

watchPoints.text: Ask Peter may get too easy a lead and could stop quickly in the straight given recent poor form and long absence
Little Venice has starting issues and could be slowly away, compromising her chances from already difficult hold-up position
Just A Heartbeat wears a hood for the first time which could either help or hinder her concentration
Miracles Do Happen has tongue tie added after going too keenly last time, suggesting ongoing settling problems
Both Mulholland runners Aquifolia and Little Venice returning from breaks, watch for market moves indicating readiness

races.name: Stables Business Park Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Wicked Thoughts
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner with course-winning form who should get an uncontested lead but may struggle to repel late challengers over this extended trip.
runners_data.comment: Won here in November and steps up in distance.
runners_data.spotlight: Made a winning chase debut at this track (2m7f, good to firm) in November off 1lb lower mark; put a poor run behind him when third of six back here (2m7f, good) last month and must come into consideration if he adapts to the step up in distance.

runners_data.name: Autonomous Cloud
runners_data.note: Prominent racer switching stables with decent past form but long absence since last win and trainer struggling with new arrivals.
runners_data.comment: Beaten favourite on stable debut at Doncaster in February but dropped to career-low mark
runners_data.spotlight: Won three times over fences for Fergal O'Brien; beaten favourite on his stable debut at Doncaster (3m, good to soft) in February but has now dropped to a career-low mark.

runners_data.name: Anytrixwilldo
runners_data.note: Won this race last year from prominent position but now 3lbs higher in the weights with 5lb-claiming jockey potentially inexperienced in tactical races.
runners_data.comment: His sole success came when landing this race last year off 3lb lower mark.
runners_data.spotlight: His sole success came when landing this race last year (good to firm) in first-time cheekpieces off 3lb lower mark; has ran with credit since when placed and his second at Ludlow (3m, good to soft) in February will have set him up nicely for a repeat bid.

runners_data.name: Puddlesinthepark
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer ideally suited to this race shape with recent course form, though 10lb claimer Radford needs to time his challenge perfectly.

runners_data.name: Always Busy
runners_data.note: Versatile prominent runner in good current form who benefits from stepping up in trip, with in-form trainer Christian Williams.
runners_data.comment: Dual winning chaser who confirmed his well-being when second at Southwell eight days ago.
runners_data.spotlight: Dual winning chaser who confirmed his well-being when second of four finishers at Southwell (3m, good) eight days ago; steps up in trip and if that brings about any improvement then he should be in the firing line.

runners_data.name: Moroder
runners_data.note: Experienced prominent racer carrying top weight at age 12, showing signs of decline but capable on his day with decent recent course form.
runners_data.comment: Six-time chase winner but now appears to be on the downgrade.
runners_data.spotlight: Six-time chase winner but now appears to be on the downgrade; pulled up when bidding to win the Grimthorpe at Doncaster for the third time in February and was tailed off at Ascot (2m5f, good) 11 days ago; can only be watched at present.

races.paceDynamic: Wicked Thoughts will lead from the start as the only confirmed front-runner, with prominent racers Autonomous Cloud, Anytrixwilldo, Always Busy and Moroder settling just behind. The pace should be sustainable rather than fierce given the 3m4½f trip and lack of pace pressure on the leader. Puddlesinthepark will be held up at the rear by Radford looking for late momentum. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce a finishing kick, as the moderate early gallop will leave plenty in reserve for those coming from off the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes Late
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace remains steady and fences are jumped cleanly
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop will suit Puddlesinthepark perfectly, allowing him to unleash his trademark late surge when others have used their stamina reserves. His hold-up style becomes a decisive tactical advantage in this race shape.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Wicked Thoughts gets an uncontested lead and jumps fluently
scenarios.body: He can dictate terms throughout and prove too strong in the closing stages, especially given his course-winning form and relatively light weight. The lack of early pace pressure allows him to reserve energy for a strong finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens approaching the business end and prominent runners get first run
scenarios.body: Always Busy or Anytrixwilldo can strike from their forward positions before the hold-up horses get organized. Their prominent style allows them to capitalize on any faltering by the leader while staying ahead of late closers.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses make jumping errors or the pace becomes stop-start
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical affair where experience and class matter most, potentially suiting the older Moroder despite his recent decline. Any horse able to adapt to the changing rhythm could benefit from others' misfortunes.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Wicked Thoughts gets headed turning for home as he may not respond to pressure over this demanding trip.
Monitor Puddlesinthepark's position at halfway as Radford must have him within striking distance to utilize his finishing kick.
Observe Always Busy's jumping rhythm as his recent Southwell run suggests he's in good heart but fences will test his stamina reserves.
Check if Anytrixwilldo's claiming jockey Macey gets caught out of position in the tactical battle, potentially compromising his chances despite the weight allowance.
Note whether Autonomous Cloud shows any ring-rustiness early given his 41-day break and stable switch to Harry Derham.

races.name: Stag Environmental Polaris Exmoor Devon Somerset Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Just A Rose
runners_data.note: Natural leader returning from two pulled-up efforts but won over course and distance on debut, stepping up in trip may help
runners_data.comment: Made a winning debut here in January 2025 but has not gone on from that so far.
runners_data.spotlight: Made a winning debut here (2m3f, good to soft) in January 2025 but has not gone on from that so far; pulled up on her last two starts, she steps up in trip with a tongue-tie and cheekpieces both on for the first time; still lightly raced but needs to get back on track.

runners_data.name: Earth King
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning after 217 days off, needs to drop in handicap marks but has winning form at this level
runners_data.comment: Has four wins over hurdles but is 2lb above his last winning mark.
runners_data.spotlight: Has four wins over hurdles but is 2lb above his last winning mark; returns from a break and probably needs to come down a few pounds.

runners_data.name: Inferno Sacree
runners_data.note: Front runner in excellent form with recent course and distance win, Murray Dodd's 7lb claim is valuable in small field
runners_data.comment: Stepped up to this trip when successful over C&D in February and followed up last month.
runners_data.spotlight: Showed improved form when stepping up to 3m to land his sixth success over hurdles, over C&D (good to soft) in February and followed up at Plumpton (3m1f, good to soft) last month; remains unexposed as a stayer and holds strong claims to land a three-timer.

runners_data.name: Al Sayah
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist with all four wins in May, returning to peak month after disappointing comeback at Plumpton
runners_data.comment: Returned from her winter break when last of four at Plumpton last month.
runners_data.spotlight: All four wins over hurdles have came in the month of May; returned from her winter break when last of four at Plumpton (2m2f, good to soft) last month; should be sharper and steps up in trip but is 10lb above her last winning mark.

races.paceDynamic: Just A Rose and Inferno Sacree are both confirmed front runners who will contest the early lead in this small field. With two natural pace-setters battling from the start, they'll create an honest gallop over this stamina-testing 3m trip on good ground. Earth King will sit prominently behind the leaders while Al Sayah will be held up at the back by Jack Tudor. This pace scenario strongly favors hold-up horses like Al Sayah, who can capitalize on a strong pace up front over this extended trip.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Just A Rose and Inferno Sacree duel hard through the middle section
scenarios.body: The two leaders will weaken in the final furlong after their battle, allowing the patient Al Sayah to sweep past under Jack Tudor. This creates the perfect setup for a hold-up specialist to exploit the pace.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Inferno Sacree can establish a clear lead and dictate terms
scenarios.body: With his recent course and distance win and superior form, Inferno Sacree could get an uncontested lead and prove too strong. Murray Dodd's 7lb claim becomes crucial in a tight finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Earth King can sit perfectly behind the pace and avoid the early battle
scenarios.body: Neil Mulholland's runner could benefit from the leaders' duel while avoiding the worst of it from his prominent position. His experience and class could tell despite the long break.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Early Pace Too Slow
scenarios.trigger: If both front runners are cautious early and fail to establish a proper gallop
scenarios.body: Without sufficient pace, this becomes a tactical affair where Al Sayah's usual hold-up tactics become less effective. The race falls to whoever has the most natural speed from the front division.

watchPoints.text: Just A Rose has been pulled up in her last two starts and may not handle the step up in trip despite her early course win
Earth King is having his first run in 217 days and may need the outing despite his solid handicap record
Inferno Sacree's claimer Murray Dodd only has 1 win from 6 rides for trainer Nigel Hawke this season
Al Sayah's May record is perfect but she finished last on her seasonal comeback and may need more time to hit peak form
Watch for the early pace battle between Just A Rose and Inferno Sacree as it will determine how the race unfolds

races.name: Mike's Seventieth Birthday Celebration Handicap Chase

runners_data.spotlight: Second on her chase debut at Fakenham (2m5f, good to soft) in October but has failed to back up that run since; no improvement following wind surgery last time and has been dropped another 5lb.

runners_data.name: Illogical Logic
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with amateur jockey claiming 7lb but poor effort last time at Plumpton is concerning
runners_data.comment: Three decent runs prior to a below par effort when tailed off at Plumpton last month.
runners_data.spotlight: Just the one win in 22 starts but three decent runs when placed prior to a below par effort when tailed off at Plumpton (3m1f, good to soft) last month; his poor win record does not inspire.

runners_data.name: School For Scandal
runners_data.note: Prominent type with crucial course and distance win and may improve on better ground
runners_data.comment: Below form on his last two starts but may show improvement on this better ground.
runners_data.spotlight: Has five wins over fences including one over C&D; below form on his last two starts but may show improvement on this better ground.

runners_data.name: Fat Sam
runners_data.note: Non-runner - was prominent racer but completely out of form and beaten 45 lengths last time
runners_data.comment: Unsuccessful in three points for new yard and beaten 45l at Hereford 15 days ago.
runners_data.spotlight: Without a win since 2022 when trained by Chris Down; unsuccessful in three points for new yard and beaten 45l at Hereford (2m5f, good) 15 days ago; hard to fancy.

runners_data.name: Mcgregors Charge
runners_data.note: Prominent racer returning after 188-day break under new trainer which is a significant concern
runners_data.comment: Won at Perth last August and two good runs when placed subsequently.

races.paceDynamic: Cave Article and Boys Of Wexford are both confirmed front runners who will contest the early pace, creating an honest gallop from the outset. With only these two natural leaders in an 8-runner field, they'll set a solid tempo but won't kill each other off completely. The moderate pace will allow the prominent racers like Illogical Logic, School For Scandal and Mcgregors Charge to track within striking distance, while hold-up horses Hall Lane and Gata Ban may find themselves with too much to do. This race shape clearly favours prominent racers who can sit close to the pace and have something left for the finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the two front runners set a steady but sustainable pace without going too hard early
scenarios.body: The prominent racers tracking just behind get the perfect trip and can kick clear when the leaders tire in the final half-mile. School For Scandal's course and distance win gives him a key edge here.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of Cave Article or Boys Of Wexford gets an uncontested lead while the other sits second
scenarios.body: The leader gets an easy time of it and has enough left to hold off the challengers, with Cave Article's class edge making him more likely to see it out. His June Southwell win showed he can lead and stay.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold Up Success
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes genuinely strong with Cave Article and Boys Of Wexford going too fast
scenarios.body: The pace collapses in the final mile allowing Hall Lane to unleash his finishing kick from the rear. His runner-up effort at Huntingdon showed he still has ability when getting the right race shape.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If both front runners fade badly leaving a tactical finish with no clear leader
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the last fence where any horse with a bit of form can win. Mcgregors Charge's long absence becomes less of a factor in a slowly-run race.

School For Scandal's improvement on better ground could be crucial given his course and distance success
Mcgregors Charge faces a tough ask returning after 188 days for a new trainer with poor recent record
Hall Lane needs the two front runners to go fast early to set up his hold-up style from the rear
